تستلفوا (form VIII)
# تَسْتَلِفُوا (tastalifū) /tas.ta.li.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
# تُسْتَلَفُوا (tustalafū) /tus.ta.la.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
